purpose: thvate yā puṇyanaṃ dānapati yājana dhanasaṃtāna saptavṛddhiphala tvaritaṃ prāptanuyāt
notes: The donor/commissioner's name is partially lost in a lacuna ('lakṣyā vāhāra sivikṣā ka ‥ ‥ ta', where sivikṣā likely represents śākyabhikṣu / śrībhikṣu of Lakṣyā Bāhā in Patan). 'ragaṃto' following 'dānapatijajomāna' probably represents the Newari phrase 'rogaṃto' (together with family/household). The scribe's string 'dralivāyijoḥ' may contain a toponym/residence (e.g. a ṭol/ḍval) or a verbal form.
